m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The Magician continues to follow the Emperor's path, I see. But the Emperor is sometimes blind, and sometimes willfully so.
Long ago, Darkmoor was a world of humans, and a nexus of magical energies familiar and forbidden. Shadow Magic is the name given the latter.
And a sisterhood developed to study it, to harness it, to remove the stigma from it. Perhaps that is why Bartleby ignored what happened next.
Because a wanderer came, known to legend as Balaur. He used Shadow and weaving and nameless things and he found the Scholomance.
And the Shadow Witches were changed by it, as all Darkmoor was changed by it. They followed Balaur, his symbols, his tales of the Scholomance.
But then he was gone and all he knew was lost with him, the Scholomance closed forever. Only its would-be disciples remained.
Reflexive obedience to a hazily remembered concept they never themselves saw - that is the doctrine of the Scholomari, my former doctrine...
Until I found the very thing they sought and was repulsed by it. Now I shall tell you how to get there and we shall see how you respond.
We're here. Everyone ready to go?
The Fool must turn the Wheel and reverse the Hierophant.
I am. You are the Knave of Wands.
Yeah, Wizard, I'm coming with. This place, I know it well, and I can help you through it. And Keziah...
The Fool must turn the Wheel and reverse the Hierophant.
Yeah, that. Wait, am I the Fool?
I am. You are the Knave of Wands.
Good to know. Off we go then?
Scion, a moment. I know you seek restitution from the Broken Branch's leader and I wish you luck. But their cure... they could save us all...
...You must bring it back to us.
Well, here we are. Who says you can't go home again?

Yeah, so looks like the Gray Man was right. Our road leads to the Scholomance, which means it bends through... *sigh* ...the Black Lagoon.
We have already begun preparations to move the camp. The less time we linger here the better.
Yes, we will continue to aid you, Scion. It seems little Velma was right. In your wake lay the tatters of empire. Let the Great Houses crumble!
Two down, two to go, and the Black Lagoon is home to the House of Wands, the Scholomari. Not my favorite bunch. But Keziah can fill you in.
She's waiting for you by the fire. She has a lot to say, a lot you need to know before we get to the Black Lagoon.
